body.heading: Pip the Pup
paragraphs: Pip is a small pup. Pip has a red ball.
Pip runs and runs. Pip digs in the mud.
Now Pip is a muddy pup! Pip needs a bath.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Why does Pip need a bath? Tell the story back in your own words.
2. What do you think Pip will dream about tonight?

takeaway: Even the shortest story has a beginning, a middle and a muddy end — and new readers can find every answer in its five sentences.
materials: Just you and this page — no materials needed
supervision: A grown-up nearby is recommended for younger readers; the think-and-talk questions work well read aloud together.
safetyNotes: Reading only — no physical activity or materials are involved.
screenFreeExtension: After reading, close the screen and retell three things you learned to someone at home in your own words.
